name: Polinyà de Xúquer (Spain)
description: White field with three blue wavy stripes along the lower part, charged with a green orange tree between two lozenges of the bars of Aragon.
history: The official flag of Polinyà de Xúquer is of proportions 2:3, white or pearl grey, with a green fruited orange tree; in 2015, following the recommendations of the Generalitat Valenciana on completing local symbols after normalising the municipal arms, the town council began the procedure to approve the flag, the full council approving the proposal on 29 January 2015, and the flag was approved by resolution of 18 January 2016 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOCV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 29 April 2005.

features.role: three wavy stripes along the lower part
two lozenges of the bars of Aragon flanking the tree
